title: ETF_OBSERVATION_v1 - one observed vintage of one asset-session row
description: Minimal shared contract for Farside BTC/ETH ETF flow observations. It is a record shape, not an engine: the live owner, the settled verifier and any historical pack emit or map to it; no parallel subsystem. Research proposal (2026-09-23), not adopted. Times are never invented: a field that is not evidenced is null and its status says why.

session_date.description: US trading date the flow belongs to. Never a knowledge time.

is_trading_session.description: False for NYSE full closures; such rows are recorded but never counted as sessions or as zero flow.

source_observed_at_utc.description: When this vintage was read from the source (retrieval), or the documented time an intermediary recorded it.

verification_completed_at_utc.description: When an independent check (e.g. identical double read + parity) completed for this vintage; null if none.

knowledge_available_at_utc.description: The time from which a replay may use THIS vintage. Live: = verification_completed_at_utc (or source_observed_at_utc if the consumer accepts unverified). Historical: set only by the #1211 owner rule; null when UNKNOWN.

knowledge_time_status.description: OBSERVED = a timed capture exists; LOWER_BOUND_ONLY = only the session close is known; ASSUMED_BY_OWNER_RULE = a declared rule, never evidence; UNKNOWN otherwise.

knowledge_rule_id.description: Identifier of the owner rule when status is ASSUMED_BY_OWNER_RULE (e.g. #1211 decision id).

source_ticker_row.description: Tickers exactly as published, in published order (binding is by name, never by width).

schema_status.description: UNKNOWN_SCHEMA_REVISION must fail closed: no row may be emitted with it.

all_dash_row.description: Every fund cell is '-'. Such a row is PENDING or a closure, never a 0.0 flow, whatever the Total cell says.

finality_status.description: Nothing is ever FINAL: VERIFIED_STABLE_AT_OBSERVATION means identical double read at that time; a later differing vintage sets the earlier one to SUPERSEDED via a new record.

raw_page_sha256.description: Informational only: differs on every fetch (dynamic page).

table_content_sha256.description: Hash of the parsed table; the stable vintage identity.

x-rules: Feature knowledge time = max(knowledge_available_at_utc) over every input row of the feature (trailing windows: cumulative max). Never the row's own time alone.
A consumer may not treat session_date, session close or a calendar flag as knowledge or finality.
Historical convenience rules (ASSUMED_BY_OWNER_RULE) are for replay only and never set finality_status or feed live settlement.
Non-sessions (is_trading_session=false) and PENDING_ALL_DASH rows never increment N-session windows, never reset streaks and are never 0.0 flows.
